title: TRICARE Select Family Catastrophic Cap
content:
**Provision.** Once the **TRICARE Select** family's catastrophic total for the plan year reaches the tier's family catastrophic cap, every later line of that plan year carries no deductible and no cost share, and a line that crosses the cap is cut to the amount still remaining under it. When a line adjudicated earlier is found to have been cost-shared after the family had already reached the cap, that line is reversed with the reason catastrophic-cap reprocessing and adjudicated again with no cost share.

> **Retired clause, no longer in force.** The clause "Point-of-service charges, Prime cost shares, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count." has been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis for the family catastrophic total.

## Room under the cap

- **Remaining cap:** the tier's family catastrophic cap less the family catastrophic total for the plan year, never below zero.
- **Liability on the line:** the lower of the liability figured on the line (deductible plus cost share) and the remaining cap.

## Worked lines (hypothetical cap 3000.00)

| Family catastrophic total | Liability figured on the line | Remaining cap | Liability carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2900.00 | 250.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| 2500.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 250.00 |
| 3000.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A line that took a cost share after the family total had already reached the cap is reversed for catastrophic-cap reprocessing and adjudicated again with no cost share.

superseded_clauses: Point-of-service charges, Prime cost shares, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count.
